analyst_view.overall: Early view: Gaziantep (16th) have not won at home all season (two draws, four defeats, three goals scored) and lost six league games in a row before parting with Orhan Ak; a new coach is likely to be in place by then. Amed (3rd) have scored 28 and lost only 4-3 at Galatasaray, and Samuel Ballet, who missed that game through a red-card ban, may be back.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.7 goals and I lean lower. Amed can score two or three, but Gaziantep have managed three goals in six home games, so the 1.3 expected from them looks high and the total more likely lands around three.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. Amed's set-piece threat (six corners at Galatasaray) is balanced by Gaziantep needing to attack at home, so I stay close to the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.0 cards, already a high line. Amed's recent bookings (three at Galatasaray, plus Ballet's ban) and a desperate home side fit that, so I stay with it.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.6 shots, 13.7 of them Gaziantep's. I lean lower because Gaziantep's home attack has barely functioned, and their recent chances have come in short spells rather than sustained pressure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. Amed should provide five or so, but I expect fewer from Gaziantep than the 4.4 forecast, so I lean slightly lower.
